title: Aurora black triangle program

tellings.quote: The Aurora had also showed up as a line item in the 1987 congressional budget with $2.3 billion earmarked for it, something Lockheed had trouble explaining away.

plain: The Aurora is said to have been a secret American aircraft program, linked to sightings of black triangle-shaped craft, running from about 1987 to 1999, tied to Groom Lake, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada, and to sightings over the North Sea. Michels tells it himself, drawing on the writer Nick Cook, the magazine Jane's Defence Weekly and British Ministry of Defence documents, and he says the Aurora "showed up as a line item in the 1987 congressional budget with $2.3 billion earmarked for it, something Lockheed had trouble explaining away." If true, the US was flying a very advanced craft it never admitted to.
